purpose: Combine the two already tested inference changes without retraining, after testing each on new v3 scenes
action_order: peer avoidance within radius 0.30 at gain 1.0
comparison: For each fixed model compare combo with its base, target-only and avoid-only result on the same suite; report score and both groups' coverage and collision
screening_rule: Keep combo as a candidate only if its mean v3 score is at most 3 below target-only, cooperation collision is reduced for at least two of three models relative to target-only, and mean basic coverage is no more than 0.005 below target-only
